lessonActivities.title: Of for Possession and Quantity – Your First Step! 🎯
lessonActivities.content:
Welcome to Of and From Prepositions! These can be tricky for learners. 📚

Of for possession: Use instead of 's for things. Like: noun + of + noun.

Of for quantity/part: Shows amount or belonging.

With AdjectivesExamples
afraid of, ashamed of, aware ofafraid of spiders, aware of the problem
capable of, fond of, proud ofcapable of running, proud of her work
sure of, tired ofsure of success, tired of waiting
With VerbsExamples
accuse of, complain of, dream ofaccuse of lying, dream of traveling
hear of, remind of, think ofhear of the news, think of you

Try: The roof of the car. A cup of tea.
examples: The roof of the car.
The title of the book.
The name of the game.
It was nice of you to invite me.
It was generous of Tom to pay for lunch.
I am afraid of spiders.
She is proud of her achievements.
I accuse you of lying.
I dream of traveling the world.
A cup of tea.
Part of the team.
Made of wood.
Full of ideas.
lessonActivities.tips: 💡 Practice Tip: Use 'of' when 's doesn't work for things.

lessonActivities.title: From for Origins and Sources – Building Confidence 🚀
lessonActivities.content:
Great! Now learn From for showing origins and sources. 📈

From for origins: Where something comes from. 'From' + place/person.

From for time: From...to/until for periods.

From for material: What something is made from.

With VerbsExamples
borrow from, disappear fromborrow from the library, disappear from view
discourage from, prevent fromdiscourage from smoking, prevent from entering
protect fromprotect from the rain

Example: Kate comes from England. From 9 AM to 5 PM.
examples: Kate comes from England.
The passage is from a poem written by Lord Byron.
I work from 9 AM to 5 PM every day.
We will be in London from Tuesday until Friday.
Jane stayed from 3:30 to 5:30.
I borrowed the book from the library.
The plane disappeared from the radar.
Don't discourage him from trying.
Rain prevented us from going out.
Insurance protects you from financial loss.
Made from recycled materials.
Built from stone.
Created from plastic.
lessonActivities.tips: 💡 Memory Aid: From = starting point or source.

lessonActivities.title: Of vs From: Common Confusions – Mastery Level 🔍
lessonActivities.content:
You're almost there! Master the differences between of and from. 🎭

Of vs From: Of for possession/quantity/part. From for origin/source/material.

SituationWith OfWith From
Possessionroof of the carcar from Japan
Quantitycup of teatea from China
Partpart of the teamteam from school

Example: The color of the sky. The sky from my window.
examples: The roof of the car. (possession with of)
The car from Japan. (origin with from)
A cup of tea. (quantity with of)
Tea from China. (source with from)
Part of the team. (belonging with of)
Team from school. (origin with from)
Made of wood. (material with of)
Made from recycled paper. (source with from)
The color of the sky. (description with of)
The sky from my window. (view with from)
